en: Black‑and‑white view of a wooded valley with a small river running along the right side, lined by a stone embankment and a promenade with lampposts. In the foreground there is a short road bridge with metal railings crossing the river. Behind the trees on the left stands a multi‑storey building complex on a slope, with a larger pavilion-like structure above it bearing a large painted sign. Dense forested hills rise in the background, partially obscured by mist.
